The '''Kragis system''' was located in the [[Citlik sector/Legends|Citlik sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as the [[Bloodboilers of Kragis]].<ref name="Obsession" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kragis [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-15.<ref name="TEA" />
